english.note: Use 炒 as the everyday all-purpose verb for firing someone from a job.
Use 炒 as the all-purpose colloquial verb for dismissing someone from a job.

examples.english: The company chose to dismiss him.
Our company decided to fire the employee who was always late.
examples.traditional: 我哋公司今日炒咗嗰個成日遲到嘅員工。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 gam1 jat6 caau2 zo2 go2 go3 seng4 jat6 ci4 dou3 ge3 jyun4 gung1

english.note: Use 炒 when the food is being stir-fried or tossed in oil over high heat.
Use this especially for dry-roasting beans, seeds, or similar food in a pan, rather than for ordinary oven roasting.

examples.english: I’m going to fry the beef over high heat tonight.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 maan5 jung6 daai6 fo2 caau2 ngau4 juk6

examples.english: My mum likes to roast peanuts in a wok.
examples.traditional: 我阿媽鍾意用鑊炒花生。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 aa3 maa1 zung1 ji3 jung6 wok6 caau2 faa1 sang1
